source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
This model has room for 6 models, drawn only from these units: **YVRAINE**, **THE VISARCH**, **YNNARI ARCHON**, **YNNARI SUCCUBUS**, **YNNARI INCUBI**, **YNNARI KABALITE WARRIORS** and **YNNARI WYCHES**.

As the Declare Battle Formations step begins, you may pick 1 of your **YNNARI KABALITE WARRIORS** or **YNNARI WYCHES** units that has not been split before, and split it into 2 units as equal in size as possible, noting which models form each. Then:

- 1 of the 2 units must begin the battle embarked in this **TRANSPORT**.
- The other may begin the battle embarked in another **TRANSPORT** or be deployed on its own.

splitUnit.when: start of the Declare Battle Formations step

otherMay: be deployed as a separate unit
